Package corewar.mars

Class LoaderWarrior

java.lang.Object
corewar.mars.LoaderWarrior
public class LoaderWarrior extends Object
Loads warriors into the CoreWar RAM and initializes their processes. Provides methods for loading warriors at random positions, specific addresses, or random with anti collisions.

    • loadWarriors

      public static void loadWarriors(Warrior warrior1, Warrior warrior2, Ram ram, ProcessQueue queue)
      Loads exactly two warriors into the RAM at fixed, symmetrical positions. The first warrior is loaded at the very beginning of the memory (address 0), and the second warrior is loaded exactly at the halfway point.
      Parameters:
      warrior1 - The first warrior to be loaded into memory.
      warrior2 - The second warrior to be loaded into memory.
      ram - The memory (RAM) where the instructions will be written.
      queue - The queue where the initial processes will be added.
